description: Log in to Odoo at http://localhost:8069 with username admin and password admin. Find the quality check titled "Dimension Verification - Screen Width" and mark its result as Fail. Enter the following text in the Notes field: "Screen width measured at 118.5 cm. Specification requires 120.0 ± 0.5 cm. Measurement is 1.5 cm outside acceptable tolerance. Reject batch for rework or return to supplier." Save the result.
